unresolved.description: RFC3659 section 5 cites RFC1123 section 4.1.3.4 for corrections to RFC959 block/compressed restart; that reference is outside the selected source set, so the exact corrected marker procedure cannot be confirmed.

RFC3659 specifies FEAT and OPTS MLST feature lines and accepted fact text but refers to RFC2389 for the enclosing FEAT/OPTS command and reply rules; those general rules are unavailable in the selected source set.

RFC959 section 4.1.3 calls STOU's pathname-bearing 250 a 'Transfer Started' response, while sections 4.2 and 5.4 classify 250 as completion after 125/150. The selected sources do not resolve whether the generated name is returned before data or only at completion.
